section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Subjective Happiness Scale (SHS), a 4-item measure, and its translation into Romanian using a back-translation technique. A principal-axis EFA was conducted with the total sample (N = 453) to examine the factor structure, which indicated a single factor explaining 63.0% of the total variance. Cronbach's alpha was reported as .89 for women and .92 for men.
